subject: 🏃 Monday — Hip Complex Circuit + PT (Wk 10)
html:
Tomorrow: Hip Complex Circuit + PT — your active-recovery entry into Week 10 (peak week), the highest-volume week of the build. 20 days to race day. The session (~20 min, two rounds): 90/90 switches, adductor rockbacks, foam rolling, plus the PT mobility flush (foam roller T-spine extensions, standing lunges with hip IR + extension), then the full PT block — dead bug with banded pulldown (2–3×10 slow marches), side plank with hip abduction (top toe down, 8/side), chin tuck + lifts (2 each direction, 3s hold), and quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 reps each side).

No running, no load — just mobility and the rehab patterns that have kept the knee at 1/5 through every run of the build. This sits between today's 16-mi long run and Tuesday's 3×2 mi threshold reps on the track (7:15–7:25 pace, 3 min recovery) — the week's first quality session.

Focus cue: slow, intentional movement through the 90/90s and hip CARs — feel for any asymmetry after today's long effort, and if the right hamstring (the faint watch item from Jul 1) talks at all, note it but don't chase it with aggressive stretching.

Context: Week 10 is the peak — ~48 mi total, anchored by Sunday's 20-mi long run with the full race-fueling dress rehearsal (Maurten Gel 100 every 20–25 min + DM + CAF 100 in the back third → 70–80 g/hr). Tomorrow primes the hips without spending anything; the engine starts turning at the track Tuesday morning. Get to bed early — sleep is the best recovery tool you have after today's effort.
